items.headline: $ARB: Arbitrum Halts New Stylus Activations in Emergency
items.summary: Arbitrum paused new Stylus contract activations in an emergency security action. Active contracts still run and renew, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals.

items.headline: $BLAST L2 Shuts Down as Costs Exceed Revenue
items.summary: Paradigm-backed Ethereum L2 Blast is winding down after costs outpaced revenue. Users have until Oct. 26 to withdraw funds via the app, a blow for $BLAST holders.

items.headline: $UNI: SMBC Nikko, Nethermind Plan Compliance Hooks
items.summary: SMBC Nikko and Nethermind plan compliance hooks for $UNI pools, with an MOU alongside Uniswap Labs and Base targeting a Japan-focused DeFi gateway by mid-2027.

items.headline: $HYPE Perps Now Rival Binance Liquidity, Study Finds
items.summary: Castle Labs found Hyperliquid matched the resting liquidity of Binance, Bybit and OKX on four of five assets, with lower trading costs. $HYPE keeps closing the CEX gap.

items.headline: $ETH: Ethereum Foundation Unveils zkAPI for Private AI
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation's zkAPI lets users pay for AI models with zero-knowledge proofs, hiding payer identity. Funds sit in an $ETH vault with ZK-authorized spending.
